newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Origenes pension fund says buys Activa.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Origenes pension fund says buys Activa.

text.p: Argentine pension fund Origenes AFJP Wednesday said it has bought the Activa-Anticipar AFJP fund for around $100 million.
The deal will make Origenes the largest Argentine private pension fund, Origenes President Guillermo Alchouron told Reuters.
"The agreement was signed this afternoon. The shareholders of Origenes have bought all of the shares of Activa-Anticipar in an operation worth about $100 million," Alchouron said.
Through the purchase Origenes will now control a total $600 million of funds and have 930,000 members.
Origenes is owned 51 percent by Banco de la Provincia de Buenos Aires and 49 percent by Spain's Banco Santander.
The purchase is conditional on the approval of the private pension funds superintendency.
